_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by region decorated with two overlay layers and exported to Arrow IPC with overlay embedding enabled. The Request carries a mixed-streamability overlay slate — OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_TOTAL is a fold-only / streamable SERIES-host kind (the grand-total accumulator rides alongside the per-group accumulators in the streaming fold) and OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_SIBLING is an inherently-buffered SERIES-host kind (sibling resolution requires the materialised SeriesPayload before the (Field, Value) lookup runs). Per the mixed-mode rule in CLAUDE.md "Execution modes → Overlays", any Request mixing streamable and non-streamable overlay kinds is downgraded to the buffered Process path so ApplyOverlaysSeries surfaces a fully-finalised SeriesPayload to every per-kind handler. The paired ExportJob (the top-level export_job sibling — invisible to the runtime because types.Request ignores unknown fields by default) documents the cross-format embedding wire shape per docs/src/internals/adding-io-format.md: ExportJob.Source names the .pulse cohort, ExportJob.Format selects the arrow adapter (an OverlayAwareWriter per io/arrow), ExportJob.IncludeOverlays=true is the explicit-emit tri-state (distinct canonical-hash key vs nil-default), and ExportJob.Overlays is populated by pulse.Export from Response.Overlays at dispatch (callers running io.ExportJob directly without pulse.Export fill the slot themselves). The resulting Arrow file gains a top-level LIST<STRUCT> field named overlays carrying both layers in the FIRST record-batch — host record-batches stream byte-identically to an IncludeOverlays=false export of the same host result. Hand-copyable into the pulse api process --json | pulse api export --json pipeline: feed this Request to pulse api process --json (Response.Overlays lands on the envelope), then pipe the response into pulse api export --json with --format arrow against the same Source cohort. The on-disk .pulse byte format is unchanged — overlay embedding is exclusively a cross-format export concern. See docs/src/internals/adding-io-format.md (Overlay Embedding section) for per-format wire shapes (Arrow / Parquet LIST<STRUCT>, Excel __overlay_<name> sheets, NDJSON trailer, CSV/TSV warn-and-skip) and skills/overlay-system.md for the overlay-kind catalog + payload shapes.
